​
🦄
Download Lark's latest version to enjoy all new features!!​
​
2026.07​
​
🌐
V7.71 Upload HTML files to Lark to preview pages and review code!​
​
Docs​
  • You can preview uploaded .html files in Lark Drive, My Document Library, or Wiki, and switch between the rendered page and the code view. In addition, you can preview rendered HTML pages in chats and documents.​
Updated on 2026/07/07​
​​
2026.06​
​
📝
V7.70 Download Lark documents as Markdown for seamless cross-platform editing!​
​
Docs​
  • In the Lark desktop app or web version, you can download Lark documents as Markdown files to easily edit and use them in other tools.​
Base​
  • When selecting a field in Base for actions such as filtering, grouping, or sorting, you can search for the field name directly in the search box within the dropdown menu to quickly locate the target field. This improves efficiency, especially when your table contains a large number of fields.​
Updated on 2026/06/23​
​​
2026.05​
​
🔄
V7.68 Insert dashboard charts into Docs with automatic data sync for easier reporting!​
​
Base​
  • To better visualize data for business reports, project progress reviews, and data analysis presentations, you can insert charts from Base dashboards into Lark Docs. When the data or style of the source chart changes, the chart in the document updates automatically, so you no longer need to take and update screenshots manually.​
Updated on 2026/05/21​
​​
​
🍁
V7.67 New AI features for Base and Lark Forms!​
​
Base​
  • Quickly add records to a base by simply pasting text or images. The AI will automatically identify and intelligently match and populate the fields.​
Lark Forms​
  • Users can now use voice to answer form questions and the AI will automatically populate the right fields, speeding up completion and simplifying data collection.​
  • The phone number question type can be used to collect respondents' mobile or landline numbers, which is great for customer registrations, follow-up visits, contact lists, and more.​
Updated on 2026/05/07​
​​
2026.04​
​
⛺
V7.65 More advanced formatting and branch settings for Base automations!​
​
Base​
  • Rich text mode is now available for formatting messages and emails sent through workflows and automations, giving you more styling options to customize your message.​
  • You can choose to run all qualifying branches in Multi-branch nodes to process tasks in parallel, enhancing flexibility and efficiency.​
Updated on 2026/04/07​
​​
2026.03​
​
📊
V7.64 Interact with dashboard charts on the mobile app!​
​
Base​
  • If chart interactions are configured, you can select a data point in one chart to dynamically filter linked charts within the same dashboard for deeper, real-time analysis directly from the mobile app. ​
Updated on 2026/03/23​
​​
​
💻
V7.63 AHA PC Doctor is now available to help you resolve common issues easily!​
​
Settings​
  • If you encounter issues, such as insufficient memory, abnormal directory permissions, white screens, or lag using Lark on Windows, you can use AHA PC Doctor for diagnosis and troubleshooting.​
Updated on 2026/03/09​
​​
2026.02​
​
🎆
V7.62 Reset layout for custom Base record details pages in one click​
​
Base​
  • You can restore a custom record details page in Base to the default layout to quickly fix any customization issues you may encounter.​
  • For text-type fields, you can select search box as the slicer style to allow users to filter data through search.​
Updated on 2026/02/25​
​​
2026.01​
​
🍑
V7.60 Eliminate confusion with image highlights in comments!​
​
Docs​
  • When you insert an image in a document comment or reply to comments with an image, you can now draw boxes to highlight parts of the image you want to reference.​
Updated on 2026/01/20​
​​
​
⛄
V7.59 More advanced options for sending messages using automated workflows in Base​
​
Base​
  • When configuring an automation or workflow to send messages, you can choose to disable the button in the message once it's clicked. When this option is selected, and the action to perform is running a workflow or automation, you can further specify whether the button is disabled for all users or only the user who clicked the button.​
Updated on 2026/01/05​
